title: My Heel Hurts
can_do: 指出轻微不适的位置和感觉，让成人采取合适的下一步。
trigger: The child stops jumping because stepping on one heel feels sore.
stretch_response: My heel hurts when I step.
repair_response: Not my toes. My heel hurts.
setting: At home after jumping to music.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: You stopped jumping. What is bothering you?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Show me where it hurts. The top or the heel?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The heel. It feels sore when I step.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Let us stop jumping and rest your foot with me.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Okay. Can you help me sit down?

replay_cards.title: A sore finger
replay_cards.change: A finger hurts after being bumped
replay_cards.challenge: Stop, show the exact finger, describe the feeling, and let Mom check it

replay_cards.title: An itchy sleeve
replay_cards.change: The sleeve feels itchy rather than painful
replay_cards.challenge: Name the arm and feeling, pause dressing, and choose another shirt with Dad

parent_support: Ask for location and sensation without suggesting a diagnosis.
Stop the activity and use normal caregiver judgment about whether more help is needed.
